channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia kill at least 8, wound dozens
item.description: Russian officials say strikes on retailer's warehouses caused civilian casualties; Kyiv says sites used to make drones.

item.title: Indian police forcibly hospitalise activist after 20-day hunger strike
item.description: Police said protesters tried to stop them from seizing Sonam Wangchuk, causing a 'slight commotion'.

item.title: A seventh night of US strikes cuts water to villages in Iran’s south
item.description: The US has bombed bridges and energy infrastructure in the seventh straight night of attacks on Iran.

item.title: At least 14 dead after minibus rolls off mountain road in Peru
item.description: At least 14 people have been killed and five injured after a minibus in the Peruvian Andes lost control on a curve.

item.title: Iranian official says the policy of negotiating during war is over
item.description: Mohsen Rezaee has warned that if the US continues bombing Iran, Tehran will escalate its response into full-scale war.

item.title: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night
item.description: Iran has retaliated against US allies in the region, with Kuwait reporting that a power and water plant had been hit.

item.title: Laos says it can't determine cause of tourist deaths linked to methanol
item.description: Officials say they have no evidence of poisoning over the 2024 deaths because autopsies were not conducted.

item.title: Olympic cyclist admits to driving despite ban after crash that killed wife
item.description: Rohan Dennis pleaded guilty to driving while disqualified after police pulled him over last month.

item.title: What this desert city can teach the world about tackling heat deaths
item.description: Maricopa County in Arizona has some of the hottest temperatures, but it has reduced the number of heat-related deaths.

item.title: Watch: What to know as Genoa bridge disaster trial ends
item.description: More than 50 defendants have been on trial in Italy over the 2018 bridge collapse which killed 43 people.
